old_rule: MRCA of backbone-native species from the final 201 family x trait systems.
new_rule: MRCA of all GBOTB.extended.TPL tips assigned to each of the 45 focal families, using V.PhyloMaker2 tips.info.TPL family taxonomy.
rationale: The estimand is deep phylogenetic relatedness among plant families, so the family crown position should be defined by the backbone family itself rather than by BIEN sampling.
This removes dependence of the predictor on trait-data taxon coverage.
It eliminates an unnecessary 25.9M-row BIEN membership query while leaving the 45-family set, context scores, statistic, permutations, and interpretation unchanged.
